added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: follow-on: the autouse fixture's isolation is skipped for any module in the hardcoded set _SKILLS_DIR_SELF_ISOLATED_MODULES ({'test_doctor'}), so a new test module that patches Path.home for the skills directory but is not listed would have the fixture point the override at a session temp directory instead, and the coupling is by module name rather than by a property the module declares.

follow-on: the fixture re-spells the override variable name as its own literal CLAUDE_SKILLS_DIR_ENV = 'RECKON_CLAUDE_SKILLS_DIR' instead of importing reckon.cli's constant, so a rename of that constant would silently stop the autouse fixture isolating any test.

follow-on: reckon install-skills still writes to Path.home()/'.claude'/'skills' directly rather than through _personal_skills_dir(), so it remains outside the override the node introduced; this is out of the node's named scope.

item_verdicts.diff: read the two commits e0c2d5bc and b5d399fd gained since the prior review; e0c2d5bc reroutes the doctor skills-presence check through _personal_skills_dir(), makes the autouse fixture build its directory with tmp_path_factory.mktemp, skips the override for the test_doctor module, and replaces the inert real-home assertion with one that reads only the patched home; b5d399fd updates the evidence fragment to match.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names the sync test landing the link at the override and leaving the default home untouched; I re-ran the reviewed gate at head b5d399fd independently as 29 passed EXIT=0 and reproduced the declared mutation as 1 failed, 16 passed, EXIT=1 at tests/test_doctor_session_host_link.py:404, the id the reviewed manifest names.
item_verdicts.goal: the reviewed node keeps every test's reckon sync and doctor away from the operator's real ~/.claude/skills; the delta completes that goal for the doctor skills-presence check, which at reckon/cli.py:8177 now resolves _personal_skills_dir() instead of a hardcoded Path.home()/'.claude'/'skills', so all three named sites (sync link cli.py:267, doctor skills cli.py:8177, doctor link cli.py:8194) honour RECKON_CLAUDE_SKILLS_DIR.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it carries status complete, names both gate logs, records the sole failing id test_sync_links_into_the_override_and_elsewhere_nothing in the negative control, and lists one follow-on for reckon install-skills at cli.py:8652.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared scope is reckon/cli.py, tests/conftest.py, tests/test_doctor_session_host_link.py and the evidence fragment; git diff --stat 9bdf6250a..b5d399fd touches exactly those four and nothing else across the two gained commits.

justifications.durability: the sync test now fails under the declared mutation and no longer reads the operator's real home, but the fixture's isolation is bypassed by a hardcoded module-name set at tests/conftest.py:1071, so the instrument's protection is selected by a literal name rather than by a property the modules declare.
justifications.evidence: I independently reproduced the head gate at b5d399fd in a scratch extraction as 29 passed EXIT=0 and reproduced the declared mutation (sync hardcoding Path.home) as 1 failed, 16 passed, EXIT=1 at tests/test_doctor_session_host_link.py:404, so the guard is shown to fire rather than merely to pass.
justifications.fit: the added names (_SKILLS_DIR_SELF_ISOLATED_MODULES, isolated_claude_skills_dir) describe mechanism with no version, plan or ticket identifier and no attribution, but tests/conftest.py:1063 still re-spells the override variable as its own literal instead of importing reckon.cli's CLAUDE_SKILLS_DIR_ENV, carried unchanged from the base.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the delta closes the one residual gap the prior review named at cli.py:8177, so doctor's skills-presence check now resolves the same override as the link check (cli.py:8194) and the sync path (cli.py:267), and the goal holds structurally rather than because the sibling test_doctor module patches Path.home.
justifications.reuse: the delta reuses _personal_skills_dir and the existing isolated_claude_skills_dir fixture rather than forking a second resolver or a per-module home helper, so no capability is duplicated.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 9bdf6250a..b5d399fd touches exactly the four declared paths, reckon/cli.py (+5/-2), tests/conftest.py (+23/-2), tests/test_doctor_session_host_link.py (+8/-30) and the evidence fragment (+7/-7), and creates no file outside them.
